note: Replies are canned: the tools were called directly, without an LLM.

tools.name: stac_search
tools.description:
stac_search(west: float, south: float, east: float, north: float, dtime: str, collection: str = 'sentinel-2-l2a', url: Optional[str] = 'https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/') -> str - Perform a STAC search for Sentinel (sentinel-2-l2a) or Landsat (landsat-c2-l2) L2 images.
        The area of interest is a bounding box in WGS84 degrees: west (min longitude), south (min latitude),
        east (max longitude), north (max latitude). dtime is an ISO date range like 2024-07-01/2024-07-31.

tools.name: view_footprints
tools.description: view_footprints() - Load Sentinel & Landsat STAC item footprints to a map. Not for images. DO NOT use for Aqua/Terra/MODIS.

tools.name: plot_metadata
tools.description: plot_metadata(field: str = 'eo:cloud_cover') - Plot any field from the current STAC items, e.g. cloud cover. No images, just STAC metadata fields.

tools.name: show_datacube
tools.description: show_datacube() - Display the image viewer for the current items (images). Currently only supports RGB views, no spectral indices.
